signals_info.description: One-sample Boolean event indicating completion of the lane change.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At the current time or at some future time, the lane-change completion event shall equal 1.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 在当前或未来某个时刻，变道完成事件应为 1。
nl_Paraphrase_en: The lane change shall be recorded as complete now or at some later time.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 变道应在当前或之后某个时刻被记录为完成。
